ai_summary: Affle 3i Limited reported strong Q1 FY2027 results, achieving over 20% year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, marking its 14th consecutive quarter of sequential top-line expansion. Despite macroeconomic and regulatory headwinds impacting specific customer segments, over 95% of revenues grew above 25% year-on-year, demonstrating robust underlying performance and stable EBITDA margins. The company is strategically focused on Developed Market expansion through the AdColony asset acquisition and active due diligence for a larger M&A by early 2027, alongside continuous AI-powered platform innovation.
